before: Inserted text refuses \v, and automation hosts refuse Line breaks.
after: Inserted text writes each \v as an inline w:br element, and automation hosts plan a Line break as an insertion of \v, tracked when an author is tracking.
reason: The w:br element is the one the editor already writes and replicates for a soft return. Replicas exchange the resulting tree content, not the inserted string, so no shared field, operation shape, or protocol message changes.
